claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: RS-45041-190 is a high-affinity I2 imidazoline receptor ligand that stabilizes lysosomes and inhibits oxidative cytotoxicity rather than killing cells, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
